styleguide.title: Design system
styleguide.subtitle: Every component in the MG Holding portal, in both languages and both themes. The company accent is switchable, because no screen may depend on a particular one.
styleguide.worldText: Every record in this portal is a labelled specimen: an identity, its measured values with units, and a provenance line saying who last touched it. A ticket, a room, a colleague and an announcement are all read the same way, so one reading habit covers the whole product.

notes.colour: The neutral scale is a warm stone, tinted at OKLCH hue 74. The accent arrives at runtime from the Company record and every brand value below is derived from it, with AA guaranteed for any hue.
notes.type: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, self-hosted, two weights. Digits always come from the Latin face, so numerals line up identically in both languages.
notes.space: One 4px pitch. The 1px hairline is the only sub-pitch value and the portal's only structural separator.
notes.labelstrip: The signature. It always carries the record's real fields, never decorative labels. Hover or focus a card to see the strip register.
notes.tables: Below 640px every row becomes a label card and each cell takes its column name as a micro-label. Resize the window to see it.
notes.elevation: Elevation is declared once per element: a hairline or a shadow, never both. Cards take the hairline; only dialogs, toasts and popovers float.
notes.motion: One authored moment, on the label strip. Everything else is a plain state change. All of it stops under reduced motion.
notes.dates: Native pickers, restyled. Stored in UTC, shown in Cairo time. The working week runs Sunday to Thursday.
notes.arabic: Arabic is designed for, not mirrored. It gets its own leading and measure, and never takes uppercase or letter-spacing: the micro-label's small-caps treatment is replaced by weight and colour rather than applied and broken.
